description: This file defines the SubscriptionPlan class within the Opencart admin module, providing CRUD operations and management for subscription plans in an e-commerce platform. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, copying, and retrieving subscription plans and their descriptions.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: A model class managing subscription plan data, performing database operations related to subscription plans, their descriptions, status, and retrieval functions within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Creates a new subscription plan record in the database and adds its descriptions for each language.

methods.name: editSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription plan record and its descriptions.

methods.name: copySubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing subscription plan by duplicating its data and descriptions.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Deletes a subscription plan and its related descriptions and product subscriptions.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription plan along with its description for the current language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves multiple subscription plans with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a subscription plan.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription plans given current filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description record for a subscription plan in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description records for a subscription plan.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes description records by language across all plans.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all description records for a specific subscription plan.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all description records for a specific language.
